text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower in new crop contracts on CBOT soycomplex calls and hot, dry weather on the Prairies. August canola was called down C$4 by some analysts to correct for Wednesday near limit gains while other expected more end-user demand Thursday to drive August values higher. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -12.02 Wednesday from -8.31 Tuesday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3809, fell to 83.72 yen and rose to 1.3271 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on spill over pressure.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on CBOT corn calls and watching weather.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn and wheat calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
